fields.label: Frappe Cloud
fields.description: We are a press customer rather than its operator. This token is the whole provisioning boundary; nothing here ever reaches a server or its agent.

fields.label: Press Root Domain
fields.description: What press calls a site. Its own Root Domain, not ours: press refuses any other, and a workspace is reached at our name because a Worker rewrites Host to this one.

fields.label: Workers KV Namespace
fields.description: The namespace the edge router reads. One key per workspace, its slug to its press site name — that is the whole of what Cloudflare is told. The token needs Workers KV Storage: Edit on this namespace and nothing else.
Every workspace is reached at <slug>.<this>. One level below the apex on purpose, so a certificate for it cannot also cover the marketing site or this one.
fields.label: Workspace Domain
Storage
fields.description: Two buckets and only two. A tenant is a prefix inside one of them, chosen at signup and permanent afterwards: R2 pins a bucket to its jurisdiction at creation.

fields.label: Stripe
fields.description: The webhook secret is not optional. A missing one makes signature checking refuse rather than skip — see one_admin/signing.py.

fields.label: When money stops
fields.description: Days on each rung before falling to the next. Zero means never, not tonight: an operator who clears one is asking for the ladder to stop.

fields.label: Overdue For
fields.description: Nothing happens to the workspace. Somebody is told, and its own header says so.

fields.label: Suspended For
fields.description: Press deactivates the site. It answers a page, nobody can log in, and the data is untouched.

fields.label: Archived For
fields.description: Press has destroyed the site, having taken an offsite backup first. Our R2 prefix is still there. At the end of this the prefix is deleted, which is the only thing on the ladder that destroys anything of ours.
